bootstrap.null_secondary_ci_omission: Predeclared: null arms receive nDCG10 CIs only; all null point secondary metrics are retained. Fixed arms receive all-metric CIs in both scopes.

implementation.anchor_scope: exact Phase-A top-50 retained QIDs for every fixed and null arm
implementation.entity_only: identity Gram over frozen top-50 anchors

sampler.sampler: k smallest SHA256(seed_digest || '|' || target), target as collision tie-break

metric_definitions.auc: mean per-impression pairwise AUC; 0.5 within the same first-score-anchored tolerance group; both-class only
metric_definitions.pair_accuracy: micro correctness under frozen deterministic total rank
metric_definitions.pair_tolerance_tie_fraction: eligible positive-negative pairs resolved only by tolerance-group SHA tie
